name: ascii-diagrams
description: Draw and check ASCII and Unicode box diagrams and tables: a skill with width-aware generators and a checker, plus a hook that checks what is written.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Path to a Python 3.9 or newer interpreter. Empty means python3 on PATH.

extensions.title: Checked extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions whose writes and edits are checked for box diagrams.

triggerCard.title: Trigger card
triggerCard.description: Add a short reminder to the system prompt to use the ascii-diagrams skill before typing a diagram.
